proxy_basis: Not a proxy: the driver is the facility's own declared abstraction, spread weekly by a stated reconstruction (the main contrasts are repeated under the three pumping reconstructions, CLAUDE.md §3).
approval_basis: Design decisions of CLAUDE.md §3, approved by Assil on 2026-10-23: abstraction lowers the head.

proxy_basis: Gate 3 point 7, decided by Assil on 2026-11-20 and clarified on 2026-11-21: the effective rainfall of the cells over the outcrop of the well's unit stands for diffuse recharge; the models' main recharge stress over the same cells is rain minus a fitted share of evapotranspiration (the hydrology reference's form, validation NSE 0.51 against 0.45 for effective rainfall), effective rainfall as is a sensitivity row, max(PE, 0) dropped.
approval_basis: Gate 3 point 7 (Assil, 2026-11-20): more effective rain does not lower the head, so the recharge gain is non-negative on every recharge edge; the omitted pathways (lateral inflow, vertical leakage, river exchange, canal return flow) stay named on each influence.

proxy_basis: Gate 3 point 10 (Assil, 2026-11-20): a pool gauge's weekly discharge is an adequate stand-in for the river stage near the well, with the caveat that withdrawals, regulation and inflows lie in between.
approval_basis: Gate 3 point 8 (Assil, 2026-11-20): eligible river signs constrain (a higher stage does not lower the head where river and unit exchange water, whatever the direction: Harbaugh 2005, doi:10.3133/tm6A16); statements about a whole groundwater body stay ineligible; a conflicting documented direction elsewhere keeps an eligible sign eligible, since the sign concerns the stage, not the direction.

proxy_basis: v5 routes each canal-edge well its own river basin's intake volumes (the Têt basin for the two eligible wells; T60, docs/canal_basins.md) instead of the plain's sum that Gate 3 point 10 judged too weak; the weekly series is still an annual total spread by the climatic deficit, and no command area says which parcels a canal serves (CQ6).
approval_basis: Assil, 2026-11-26 (docs/analysis_plan_v3.md §8 item 1): hard ≥ 0 on the eligible canal edges, those with a measured or traced return into the well's own unit (MILLAS C2-1: geochemical mixing at the well, BRGM/RP-71486-FR p. 24; 10915X0395/PZ: canal losses into 718BP02 by differential gauging, p. 29); free elsewhere; Gate 3's free sign as a sensitivity row.

proxy_basis: v5 plan R2.2 (docs/analysis_plan_v3.md §2, 2026-11-25): the effective rainfall of the cells over the outcrop of the unit lying directly above the well's unit at the well stands for overlying-leakage recharge, in the same way as diffuse recharge over the well's own outcrop.
approval_basis: v5 plan R2.2 (docs/analysis_plan_v3.md §2, 2026-11-25): by Darcy's law the flux through the contact grows with the upper head whatever its direction, so more effective rainfall on the overlying unit does not lower the well's head; non-negative gain, with the omitted pathways (lateral inflow, river exchange, canal return flow) named on each influence.
